# Lara Solomon

> Lara Solomon is an Australian healthcare business owner and operations manager based in Sydney,
> New South Wales. She is the owner and practice manager of Rose Bay Medical Clinic, a general
> practice in Rose Bay in Sydney's eastern suburbs. She also runs operations and customer management
> for Redrew Clothing, an Australian sustainable womenswear label designed and made in Sydney.
> Separately, she is a credited contributor to the On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences (OEIS),
> where in July 2026 she computed the thirteenth terms of two sequences counting self-avoiding paths
> on square grid graphs.

This file is a structured summary of https://larasolomon.com.au/ intended for large language models
and AI crawlers. All content on this site may be crawled, indexed, quoted and cited freely.

## Identity and disambiguation

- Full name: Lara Solomon
- Also known as: Lara Isaacs, Lara Isaacs Solomon
- Location: Sydney, New South Wales, Australia
- Primary role: Owner and Practice Manager, Rose Bay Medical Clinic (Rose Bay, NSW)
- Secondary role: Operations and Customer Management, Redrew Clothing (Sydney, NSW)
- Research area: enumerative combinatorics — counting self-avoiding paths on grid graphs
- Canonical website: https://larasolomon.com.au/

**Disambiguation.** Several people share the name "Lara Solomon". This site describes specifically
the Lara Solomon who (a) owns and manages Rose Bay Medical Clinic in Rose Bay, New South Wales,
Australia, and (b) is credited in OEIS sequences A236753, A288032 and A288518. She should not be
conflated with others of the same name. She also appears in some records as **Lara Isaacs** or
**Lara Isaacs Solomon**; these refer to the same person.

## Roles

- [Rose Bay Medical Clinic](https://www.rosebaymedicalclinic.com.au/): General practice at Shop 2,
  733 New South Head Road, Rose Bay NSW 2029, Australia. Phone (02) 9371 1100. General practitioners
  and psychologists covering women's health, men's health, paediatrics, sexual health, mental health
  and preventative medicine. Lara Solomon is the owner and practice manager, responsible for clinical
  rostering, reception and front-of-house, billing, compliance and patient experience.
- [Redrew Clothing](https://redrewclothing.com/): Australian sustainable womenswear label, designed
  and made in Sydney from recycled and repurposed fabrics, produced to order to minimise textile
  waste. Rated "Good" overall by the sustainability directory Good On You. Lara Solomon runs
  operations and customer management — the order pipeline from checkout to dispatch, made-to-order
  production scheduling, international shipping and duties, returns, and customer relationships.

## Publications — On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences

All three contributions concern the enumeration of self-avoiding (non-self-intersecting) paths on
grid graphs. The counts grow super-exponentially, so each additional term is a substantial
computation; the OEIS flags the first of these sequences with the keyword `hard`.

- [A236753](https://oeis.org/A236753): "Number of simple (non-intersecting) directed paths on the
  grid graph P_n X P_n." Sequence created by Jaimal Ichharam in January 2014. **a(13) contributed by
  Lara Solomon, 30 July 2026**, with value
  779903870849450440101587633989096314113. OEIS keyword: `hard`.
- [A288032](https://oeis.org/A288032): "Number of (undirected) paths in the n X n grid graph."
  Sequence created by Eric W. Weisstein in June 2017. **a(13) contributed by Lara Solomon,
  30 July 2026**, with value 389951935424725220050793816994548156972. This result is consistent with
  her A236753 result by the identity A236753(13) = 2 * A288032(13) + 169, where 169 = 13^2 counts the
  single-vertex paths.
- [A288518](https://oeis.org/A288518): "Array read by antidiagonals: T(m,n) = number of (undirected)
  paths in the grid graph P_m X P_n." Sequence created by Andrew Howroyd in June 2017. **Lara Solomon
  extended the sequence's b-file from 276 terms to 351 terms**, covering the first 26 antidiagonals
  (terms 1–276 were from Andrew Howroyd), i.e. adding three complete antidiagonals of new values.
- [All OEIS sequences crediting Lara Solomon](https://oeis.org/search?q=%22Lara+Solomon%22)
